rv.q: It looks as if Hitchcock’s stories have been put in a blender and are swirling around on stage. These morsels do not amount to much, the twists lack punch and the songs try hard to introduce some psychology but are fairly bland although there is one belter at the end, What Everybody Wants.
Hitchcock-inspired musical suffers from an identity crisis
A couple of creative tweaks could undoubtedly see this be a killer success but, in its current form, it is sadly more of a misfire.
